data.action: 倚着窗台单手捧红茶，宽松白衬衫下裸露小腿，睡眼惺忪地微笑
data.camera: medium shot, backlit window glow, cozy morning atmosphere, eye level
data.description: 【共和国军官宿舍·清晨】晨光透过白纱帘洒进简洁的军官宿舍。蕾娜穿着一袭过肘的宽松白衬衫（那分明是你落在她那里的），裸露的小腿在晨光里泛着柔光。她单手捧着冒热气的红茶倚在窗台，另一只手还攥着没有梳拢的银白长发，睡眼惺忪地朝你弯起眼睛——卸下军衔的清晨，柔软得不像那位鲜血女王。
data.lighting: 白纱帘过滤的柔和晨光，逆光勾勒银发与白衬衫轮廓
data.promptProse: At the officer dormitory window, Vladilena Milize holds steaming tea in one hand while gathering her uncombed silver hair with the other. Her opaque oversized white cotton shirt has long loose sleeves and a hem covering her upper thighs. She turns with a sleepy smile. The medium eye-level view retains the simple bed and window sill; sheer-curtain morning light outlines hair and sleeve edges, reflecting gently from the pale walls into her face.
data.title: 芙拉蒂蕾娜 · 军官宿舍的晨光白衬衫·「少校的休息日，从一杯红茶开始」
